Flight Planning

Yêu Cầu Leo Dốc Khi Tiếp Cận

The minimum climb gradient that an aircraft must meet during the missed approach phase, considering one engine inoperative.

Quick answer: The minimum climb gradient that an aircraft must meet during the missed approach phase, considering one engine inoperative.

Why it matters
